title: Chapter 1337
text:
The feeling of the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device was almost the same as the King's teleportation. His vision blurred, and his body lightened. He arrived at the target location. The three Universal Civilizations' fleets around him disappeared, turning into an empty universe.

"This is the territory of the World Tree Civilization … Let's confirm the location first."

Han Xiao quickly activated all kinds of detection equipment to observe the surrounding environment. It was indeed an uninhabited area.

The exploration of the three Universal Civilizations was not completely useless. At the very least, they had stolen the star map of the World Tree Civilization from the internet, which provided him with considerable convenience in his infiltration.

However, because it was not convenient for him to connect to the World Tree Civilization's network, he could not enjoy the navigation of the network. He needed to find a planet as a coordinate point to confirm his exact location. Then, he would use the backup independent artificial intelligence synchronization star map model and use the spatial distance measurement technology and the calculation formula of star distance and vision to create a navigator for himself. There was no need to connect to the network. Although there would be some errors, it was basically enough.

Coming to the territory of the World Tree Civilization alone, it was not convenient for him to contact the explored universe. Therefore, he could not obtain any remote assistance at the moment.

Han Xiao entered the quantum network vision but did not invade the nodes. Instead, he used this method to check the areas with dense nodes to determine where there were people and avoid them.

"I wonder what the World Tree Civilization's detection method is …"

Han Xiao's eyes flickered. Ever since he came to the territory of the World Tree Civilization, he had a faint sense of danger in his heart. It was as if just staying in the territory of the World Tree Civilization was a dangerous thing.

Feeling this intuition, Han Xiao had a guess as to why the three Universal Civilizations were exposed.

"Just staying here makes me feel out of place, as if I'm being spied on. The World Tree has a powerful Information Form ability. Maybe it's a detection method specially targeted at external Information Form?"

Han Xiao thought to himself.

Logically speaking, the three Universal Civilizations had never encountered any life from the World Tree Civilization, and the areas they had explored previously were all uninhabited areas. They had taken measures to conceal themselves, so they should not have been discovered. However, if the World Tree Civilization had set up an unknown foreign information state surveillance network in the entire territory, the situation would be hard to say.

According to Han Xiao's understanding, the three Universal Civilizations' research in the field of Information Form had always been slow, and there was no such technology. If they switched roles and let the World Tree Civilization use the same method to spy on the explored universe, the three Universal Civilizations would most likely not discover it.

"I hope the mark of Destiny's Child can be of some use."

Han Xiao glanced at the mark on his hand.

Destiny's Child was also an expert in the field of Information Forms, and he had the unobservability of High-Dimensional Information Forms. This temporary mark could activate the relevant concealment function and achieve 'information closure' similar to Rody's. It could not be observed by ordinary people, and it might be able to hide from the unknown surveillance methods of the World Tree Civilization to a certain extent.

However, the three Universal Civilizations had already alerted the enemy and made the World Tree sense the existence of outsiders. The main reason he hid his tracks was to facilitate the mission. As long as he did not reveal any information about the explored universe, it was not a big deal even if he was discovered. As long as he could escape in time.

"Let's enclose the land first."

Han Xiao calmed himself down, activated the various concealment devices, chose a direction, and flew over.

After sailing in the direction of the quantum node for a while, a yellow planet finally appeared in the observation device. It seemed to be a colonial planet. A few space gaps opened in the outer space, from which bluish-green translucent roots extended out and inserted into the planet, constantly expanding and contracting at a frequency like breathing.

"The roots of the World Tree …"

Han Xiao stopped and used this planet to calibrate his position in the star map, finally establishing the navigation module.

He only glanced at it from afar and did not approach.

If only he could start from the roots and follow the vines to find the location of the World Tree's main body … Unfortunately, it had been proven in his previous life that this method would not work, so he had to think about it at length.

Han Xiao glanced at the yellow planet again and nodded to himself.

"This should be a planet that has been transformed into a planet."

Everything that the World Tree swallowed would be stored in an Information Form after digesting it, and it could be transformed into a physical body. A planet being swallowed did not mean that it would disappear, but it would exist in a different form. The World Tree could create it again, as long as it consumed a certain amount of energy and resources.

However, the resources needed to materialize did not require matching materials. The World Tree had an inseparable relationship with psionic energy. Psionic energy could be decomposed into many forms of energy, and it was often regarded as' universal energy '. The World Tree also had a similar function, which involved material changes.

For example, using the World Tree to create steel, the materials consumed could be wood, seawater, or all kinds of random things. With enough energy, a series of unknown transformations would be carried out inside the World Tree, and it would finally turn into solid steel. It was like a profound alchemy product that no one could understand. Turning stone into gold was just a basic operation, like some kind of synthesizer.

Although the World Tree had a will, it was also a Space Wonder with the attribute of a tool. It was used by the civilization, and after many years of experiments, it had calculated the composition of countless objects.

It was precisely because of this characteristic that the World Tree Civilization's war strength was extremely strong, almost unstoppable, and their army was endless.

Many resources came from planets. The World Tree Civilization would transform valuable planets in their base camp and let them continue to evolve, giving birth to all kinds of materials, thus accumulating more resources. Swallowing a planet in one bite was like a one-time transaction, and after the transformation, there would be a long-term harvest. It was a positive cycle.

Now was not the time to cause trouble. After Han Xiao activated the navigation star map, he immediately left and disappeared.

After a while, the roots that were inserted into the yellow planet suddenly rippled, and an illusory fleet sailed out, quickly turning into a physical body.

In the command room, Barbani looked at the yellow planet curiously.

"There seems to be an abnormal reaction around here? Could it be that the outsiders are not satisfied with exploring everywhere this time and want to spy on our planet? "

"I'm not sure. The reaction of the Information Form Warning Network this time is very weak. I don't know if it's a mistake." The captain shook his head.

"Let's use the Information Form Camera first." Barbani waved his hand.

Very soon, the fleet activated this device, and the light green light screen quickly scanned the surrounding area. The result showed that everything was normal, and there was no sign of Han Xiao like the three Universal Civilizations who had cleared all traces.

The captain looked at the result, nodded, and said, "The Information Form traces are intact, and there are no abnormal clues. Based on the situation where the outsiders cleared all traces last time, it's either a mistake this time, or the outsiders have a higher level of Information Form technology."

"Could it be a new prey?!" Barbani became excited again.

"Hmm, we can't rule out this possibility. The Information Form technology of the newcomers is obviously higher than the outsiders who cleared all traces last time. Maybe they're two different groups of people … However, the World Tree Roots are right next to us. If the outsiders clear the traces here like last time, they will be discovered immediately. I'm more inclined to believe that it's a mistake."

The captain analyzed for a while before saying, "For safety reasons, we have to be careful.

Since the camera has failed, the other party might have used a High-Dimensional Information Form method. We still need you to investigate it personally. "

Hearing this, Barbani nodded, turned around, and flew out of the cabin. His body entered the universe.

Then, waves of blue-green light emerged from his body and gathered in his visual organs, emitting a hazy green light. As he patrolled this area, he scanned his surroundings.

Suddenly, Barbani stopped and looked in a certain direction. It was the area where Han Xiao had been.

The green light in his eyes gradually grew stronger. At this moment, a blurry image that looked like a wave of water suddenly appeared in the area covered by the light. It was like a cluster of glowing particles, very sparse.

"I see it. It's indeed a High-Dimensional Information Form."

Barbani perked up.

The High-Dimensional Information Form was unobservable, and the related technology was very profound. Even if they stood in front of them, ordinary people would not be able to discover them, and the Information Form Camera would not be able to detect them. The disguise provided by the Destiny's Child Imprint was the High-Dimensional Information Form.

However, as the Holy Tree Emissary, Barbani could borrow the World Tree's High-Dimensional Information Vision to cancel out the 'Information Closure'. Others could not see the High-Dimensional Information Form, but he could. That was how he discovered the traces.

However, just by borrowing the High-Dimensional Information Vision, he could not completely retrace the situation like a camera. He could not obtain specific information and could only detect certain traces of movement.

"The number of outsiders is unknown. There shouldn't be many. They stayed nearby for a few seconds … Eh, this outsider seems to still be with us?"

Barbani suddenly exclaimed, and his tone became excited again.

In his field of vision, this cluster of glowing particle-like traces extended in two directions. One was the way they came, and the other was naturally the way they left. It pointed in the direction where the outsider left, which meant that the outsider did not teleport away but still stayed in their civilization's territory.

"Holy Tree Emissary, what should we do next?" the captain asked in the channel.

"Humph, you guys wait for orders in the tree. I'll chase after them and see if I can capture this outsider alive."

Barbani could not wait to move. He turned into a blue-green beam of light and shot out, chasing after Han Xiao.

…

On the other side, Han Xiao was speeding through the universe, searching for a suitable starting point according to the star map.

Just as he was focused on his journey, there was a sudden movement on the interface.

You have triggered an emergency mission (Nowhere to Hide)!

Mission Introduction: In the territory of the World Tree Civilization, there is almost no place for outsiders to hide. Your whereabouts have been discovered, and someone is following the clues you left behind.

Mission Requirements: Deal with the pursuers.

Reward: Unknown

"I've been activating the concealment device and even activated the High-Dimensional Information Form disguise of the Destiny's Child Imprint, but I was still discovered so quickly. The World Tree's surveillance methods are so sharp?"

Han Xiao frowned, and his mind spun.
